question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word : **PROPHECY**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Prediction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Prophecy"** refers to a statement or prediction about future events, often made under divine inspiration or considered to be of spiritual significance. (भविष्यवाणी)
 
 
• **Example:** The prophecy foretold a great leader who would unite the kingdom.
 
 
• **"Prediction"** means a forecast or statement about what will happen in the future, often based on evidence or reasoning. (पूर्वानुमान)
 
 
• **Example:** The weather prediction for tomorrow suggests heavy rainfall.
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Prophecy"** is **"Prediction"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Prediction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Creation** (सृजन): The act of bringing something into existence.
 
 
• **Example:** The creation of the new artwork took months of meticulous effort.
 
 
 
• **Denial** (अस्वीकार): Refusal to accept or acknowledge something.
 
 
• **Example:** His denial of the accusations surprised everyone.
 
 
 
• **Decision** (निर्णय): A conclusion or resolution reached after consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** The decision to move abroad was not an easy one.
